text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Croatian Prime Minister Matesa ends two-day official visit to Kuwait. Matesa discussed political and economic ties with Kuwaiti officials.
- Trade Minister Mudaf left for Sri Lanka on Sunday for talks on bilateral trade relations.
- Medical reports say Crown Prince and Prime Minister Sheikh Saad al-Abdulla al-Sabah to resume duties after one month following colon surgery on Saturday.
- Arab League denies Iraqi accusation that Secretary-General Abdel-Meguid sided with Kuwait.
- Jordanian parliamentarian says: "Kuwait is a part of Iraq."
- World leaders wish Kuwait's Crown Prince speedy recovery.
- Central Bank's Governor Sabah says privatisation would improve economy.
- Former parliamentarians and activists to form non-governmental committee to protect public funds.
- No increase in wages and pensions, Finance Minister Rodhan says.
